title: After 3 weeks of testing the App (paper trading) and seeing it consistently pick good long positions I put some real money in
author: Bitter-Refuse-8623
selftext: I downloaded quite a few 7-8 apps that had free trials then wanted money without ever giving anything besides the top gainers list which I can just look at on fidelity or Robinhood, yahoo finance, etc. this app I think looks for leading gainers primarily with a somewhat recent stock split among other parameters. I haven't seen it recommend a single bad stock if you get it right at alert or very soon after and it only recommends between 1-5 stocks a day depending on how hot the Market is. I'm not sponsored or affiliated in any way with them but it's completely free . No add popups ever and turned my $12.75 into $23 (just testing it's accuracy) next week I'm going to put more confidence (money) in its recommended alerts especially Monday and Tuesday. They show long and short positions entry levels, news scanner , publish their own news articles and aggregate a lot of data with sources and FEC filings .

replies.author: Bitter-Refuse-8623
replies.body: ProTicker . Says the name at the top of the screenshot of said application if you need to pinpoint their symbol or whatever which is basically just the bull. It's been amazing so far with me having around 45% weekly average returns on paper and today after three weeks paper trading I mad 67% gains in about 30 seconds of actual time clicking buttons. I watch the level two heavily during halts and if it look crazy lopsided to the buyers side and halted with MACD open I execute a buy order at around 25 cents about bid/ask. When it continues and fills I immediately place a limit sell at around the same amount the stock last gapped up so for instance this morning I got in at around $3.44 a share and sold for $5.75. yes the stock went on to go to $12 but it's important to not get greedy . I make at max 3 trades a day. If I'm red or green so be it . No matter how green also , be happy with doubling your money.

comments.author: baconforbabies30
comments.body: Good post. This is exactly what I try to do. I've had seven or eight downloads of different types of bots and most of them have subscription or different price points. So without any money I don't know what's going to do well and what's not. It's great that somebody comes out and has tested a few and found a good one that they can recommend.

replies.author: Bitter-Refuse-8623
replies.body: I know a month isn't a lot of data but I had to pull the trigger after it nailed Monday and Tuesday on paper again. My plan is to focus on premarket and early market gappers that proticker recommended primarily Monday and Tuesday using 10% of capital. Today was 67% gain if you average two days at 50% to 75% gains and don't trade any other day within 2 years could be sitting pretty. I love the news scanner and they show insider , institutional, and government trades . If they continue being this good I will find a way to throw the developers some of the proceeds. Good luck whoever you are. Im not sure if it's on iOS but I can check if anyone needs me to(for whatever reason) ie blind/ impaired in some way.

replies.author: Bitter-Refuse-8623
replies.body: Yes sir or ma'am. Hopefully it does you as good as me . Don't be greedy. Watch the stock at the alert level 2 data, MACD, and volume on buyers side. If buyers side looks legitimately healthy and oversold buy in and when it hits second high of day get out . This is not financial advice and again I'm not affiliated. .
